item.title: Effects of soil fauna on early-stage litter decomposition across diverse tropical ecosystems in east Malaysia
item.description: Litterbag studies from temperate zones have shown a significant effect of soil fauna on litter decomposition. However, understanding the decomposition dynamics in tropical regions remains limited compared to temperate regions.
